ITBP Head Constable Motor Mechanic Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: ITBPF has advertised 21 Head Constable (Motor Mechanic) vacancies , including backlog vacancies. Ex-servicemen Reservation: Ten percent of the vacancies are reserved for eligible Ex-servicemen. These are included within the overall vacancies and are not additional posts. Unfilled Ex-servicemen vacancies may be filled by eligible non-Ex-servicemen candidates of the respective categories. The number of vacancies is tentative and may increase or decrease according to ITBPF requirements.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Motor Mechanic Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed 10+2 and satisfy one of the two prescribed technical qualification routes. The required qualifications must be possessed by the application closing date of 27 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Motor Mechanic Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected Head Constables (Motor Mechanic) will receive pay under Level 4 of the 7th Central Pay Commission . Selected candidates will be eligible for applicable allowances and benefits under ITBPF rules, including: Dearness Allowance. Ration Money Allowance. Special Compensatory Allowance when posted in specified border areas. Free accommodation or House Rent Allowance. Transport Allowance. Leave Travel Concession. Free medical facilities. Other admissible allowances. The appointment will be governed by applicable ITBPF rules. The notification provides for a choice between the applicable New Pension Scheme (NPS) and Unified Pension Scheme (UPS), subject to the stated rules.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Motor Mechanic Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee must be paid online through the ITBPF recruitment portal. Fees paid through any other mode will not be accepted. Fees once paid are non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Motor Mechanic Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be conducted in multiple phases covering physical fitness, eligibility verification, written examination, trade skills and medical fitness. Phase I: Physical Efficiency Test (PET) and Physical Standard Test (PST). Phase II: Verification of Original Documents and Written Examination. Phase III: Practical Skill Test and preparation of the merit list. Phase IV: Detailed Medical Examination (DME) and Review Medical Examination (RME), where applicable. Final Merit Rule: The Practical Skill Test is qualifying in nature. Final merit is prepared on the basis of written examination marks among candidates who qualify the prescribed stages.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Physical Efficiency Test 2026
content_sections.text: The Physical Efficiency Test (PET) is qualifying in nature and consists of three events. Candidates must qualify in all three events. No marks are awarded for PET, and candidates failing any event are eliminated from the recruitment process. Ex-servicemen Exemption: Eligible Ex-servicemen are exempted from PET but must qualify in PST, documentation, written examination, practical skill test and medical examination.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Physical Standard Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the applicable height, chest and weight standards. Weight: Weight must be proportionate to height and age according to the prescribed CAPF medical guidelines. Candidates claiming relaxation in height or chest standards must produce the prescribed certificate when requested by the Recruitment Board. Those dissatisfied with height or chest measurements may submit a written appeal for re-measurement to the Presiding Officer on the same day.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Medical Standards 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be medically fit and meet the notified vision and physical health standards. Visual correction of any kind, including spectacles, is not permitted for meeting the prescribed vision standard. High colour vision and binocular vision are required. Candidates must not be colour blind. Knock knees, flat feet, varicose veins and squint are not permitted under the notified medical standards. Candidates must be in good mental and physical health. Candidates must not have physical conditions that interfere with the efficient performance of duties. Tattoos are permitted only under the prescribed content, location and size restrictions. Tattoo Rule: Permitted tattoos must be on traditional locations such as the inner aspect of the left forearm or the back of the hands, and must be smaller than one-fourth of the relevant body part, subject to the notification's conditions.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Written Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The written examination carries 100 marks and consists of objective multiple-choice questions. The examination duration is 2 hours . Language Option: Candidates can choose to attempt 20 questions in either Hindi or English. The paper includes 20 Hindi questions and 20 English questions, but candidates must select one language option for the 20-mark section. Negative Marking: The supplied notification does not specify a negative-marking rule for the written examination. Candidates should follow any subsequent exam instructions issued by ITBPF. Qualifying the minimum written-test marks does not guarantee shortlisting for the practical test. Shortlisting will also depend on written-test performance and available category-wise vacancies.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Motor Mechanic Practical Skill Test 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted from the written examination will be called for a 50-mark Practical Skill Test . The test is qualifying in nature, and candidates must secure at least 50% marks. Minimum Qualifying Marks: 25 out of 50 for all categories. Candidates will be shortlisted for the Practical Skill Test up to ten times the category-wise vacancies based on their written examination performance. Important: Practical Skill Test marks are not included in the final merit list. Candidates must qualify in the test, but final merit is determined using the written examination marks.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Final Merit and Medical Examination 2026
content_sections.text: After the practical test, ITBPF will prepare category-wise merit lists based on written examination marks. Shortlisted candidates will undergo Detailed Medical Examination (DME). Those declared medically unfit may seek Review Medical Examination (RME) according to the prescribed procedure. Candidates seeking RME must submit written consent within 24 hours of receiving the DME unfitness decision. The older candidate will receive a higher merit position. If the tie continues, the candidate whose name comes first alphabetically in English will receive preference. The notification states that no reserve list will be maintained.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ITBP Head Constable Motor Mechanic Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official ITBPF recruitment website at recruitment.itbpolice.nic.in . Read the Head Constable (Motor Mechanic) Recruitment 2026 notification. Check the educational qualifications, age limit, physical standards and other eligibility requirements. Open the online application facility for Head Constable (Motor Mechanic). Create or access the required candidate profile on the recruitment portal. Enter the required personal details, gender, category, employment status and other profile particulars. Provide a valid mobile number and active email address. Enter the prescribed educational qualifications and Motor Mechanic or Automobile Engineering details. Provide relevant practical experience details, where applicable. Complete the required photograph, signature and supporting information according to the application portal instructions. Review all entered details carefully. Pay the Rs. 100 application fee online if applicable. Submit the application by 27 October 2026 at 11:59 PM . Save and print the submitted application for future recruitment stages. Application Warning: Candidates must submit applications online only. Offline applications and payments made through unauthorized modes will not be accepted. Incorrect personal or category information may lead to cancellation of candidature.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for ITBP Head Constable Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must produce original certificates for verification along with self-attested copies at the prescribed recruitment stage. Original certificates will be returned after verification, while self-attested copies may be retained by ITBPF.

content_sections.heading: ITBP Head Constable Service Conditions and Posting 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be liable to serve anywhere in India or abroad according to ITBPF requirements. Selected candidates must undergo the prescribed basic training and other courses required by the Force.
